purpose: Keep SkillScout recommendations current without treating static project data as a live Codex directory.
refresh_triggers: A user asks for currently available, newly released, installed, or recommended plugins.
A recommendation depends on whether a named skill, app, MCP server, or plugin exists now.
Codex publishes a plugin, app, skill, or marketplace update.
A maintained rule names a capability whose availability may have changed.
Official guidance changes the directory, installation, role-access, or app-permission model.
A scheduled maintainer review finds a material change in official Codex capabilities, plugin distribution, or submission requirements.
Official guidance changes how plugin or skill metadata should be evaluated for relevance, precision, or recall.
required_behavior: Inspect current-session metadata before naming a current capability.
Use official OpenAI/Codex sources for product-wide claims when available.
Treat Plugin Directory listing, installation policy, required-app access, and source-system permission as separate checks.
Use the current term ‘Plugin Directory’; do not describe the retired App Directory as the current discovery surface.
Do not invent install links, deep links, permission requirements, plan requirements, country availability, or marketplace status.
Fall back to a category-level recommendation when freshness cannot be verified.
Record verified changes in the appropriate rule, example, and documentation files before releasing a new plugin version.
Maintain direct, indirect, and negative activation prompts when changing SkillScout metadata or startup behavior.

Publish validated, low-risk documentation and decision-model updates through the public GitHub marketplace source; do not claim universal-directory publication until OpenAI approval and publisher release.
non_goals: This policy does not promise that every user session has access to background polling or a live marketplace feed.
This policy does not treat third-party listings as official Codex availability evidence.
This policy does not grant access to private app, workspace, or admin metadata.

verified_platform_changes.change: The App Directory migrated to the Plugin Directory on 2026-07-09; plugin visibility, installation policy, role/app access, and source-system authorization remain distinct checks.
verified_platform_changes.repository_effect: Use Plugin Directory terminology and preserve availability caveats in all current-capability recommendations.
